observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F16.H3 removes the call to resolve_plan_and_quota and the associated mock, and replaces the test helper with a call to resolve_quota. This indicates the production dependency resolve_plan_and_quota is no longer invoked in the path exercised by this test, and the test now directly calls resolve_quota.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support a billing or quota resolution change where the plan lookup is no longer required, or the implementation has been refactored to call resolve_quota directly. However, without the production implementation, this is unverified.

observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F16.H4 and P1.F16.H5 change the unpacking of the result tuple from (_, quota_status) to quota_status, and P1.F16.H6 and P1.F16.H7 change the mock return value from a tuple to a single QuotaResourceStatus. This indicates the production implementation no longer returns a tuple, and the tests have been updated accordingly.
